title: Choose Mapa's visual world
question: The roll assigned Sankranti Kites. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Sketches show the caretaker's Today screen.

options.label: Sankranti Kites
options.lineage: Sankranti kite-flying on Telugu rooftops: tissue-paper kites, manja string, a sky full of family
options.thesis: You hold the string, even from far away: each person you care for is a kite in your sky.
options.viewport: Today: a soft sky header where each person's kite floats, its tail ribbons = streak; below, today's calls as clear rows with status; + button bottom-right.
options.risk: Kites can turn into decoration; the sky must stay a header and the rows must do the work.

raised.raise: Ink discipline: three ink values per screen, one kite colour per person, nothing decorative beyond that.
Every status carries its proof: 'Taken' shows the line Amma actually said on the call.
Marigold is reserved for 'up next / calling now' and is never used anywhere else.
All neutrals come from one tinted sky ramp shared by light (day sky) and dark (night sky) modes.

options.label: Morning Muggulu
options.lineage: the rice-flour muggulu drawn at the doorstep every morning
options.thesis: Care as a daily ritual: every dose taken draws the next loop of the pattern.
options.viewport: Today: a red-oxide header with this week's dot-grid muggu half-drawn; today's calls listed below on a pale ground.
options.risk: The most familiar cultural-motif move for this audience, and earthier and heavier than 'between bright and pale'.

options.label: Character Roster
options.lineage: character goods catalogs: rounded mascots with name plates
options.thesis: Every person you care for becomes a character card with a name plate and a one-line note.
options.viewport: Today: a grid of person cards ('Amma · loves filter coffee'), each with a ribbon showing today's status.
options.case: Holds product clarity (the roster maps to 'Add another person'), but a busy adult and a 60+ parent identify with it less than with the kites.
options.risk: Tips into childish, and the cards compete with status.

options.label: Departures Board
options.thesis: Today as a departures board: every call has a time, a person and a live status.
options.viewport: Today: a yellow band reading 'Next: 13:30 Nanna · Metformin', with past calls as board rows.
options.case: Wins on glanceable clarity, and resonates with caretakers living away from home, but it reads as transit and runs against 'never materialistic'.
options.risk: Cold and transactional for a care product.

options.label: Centre-Rail Edition
options.thesis: A reference edition with a vermilion key rail.
options.viewport: Two text columns around a rail of reminder keys.
options.case: Bookish and austere, so it loses on both identification and clarity.
options.kept: Ink discipline: three values plus one colour per person.
options.risk: Reads as a document, not a buddy.

options.label: Monochrome Proof
options.thesis: Claim, then proof, in one neutral scale.
options.viewport: Grey Today list with one accent.
options.case: Exactly the generic, clinical look you ruled out.
options.kept: Every status shows its proof (the line said on the call).

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: The day as a course, control to control.
options.viewport: Doses as numbered controls on a course line.
options.case: Foreign to the audience and over-abstract for a status check.
options.kept: One colour is reserved for the active leg (up next).

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Translucent zone sheets with hatch density.
options.viewport: Stacked sheets of the day's calls.
options.case: Technical and dim, so it loses on both axes.
options.kept: One tonal ramp drives every neutral token.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Duolingo-style habit app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A white Today screen with a streak flame, a green CTA and a mascot speech bubble.
canonCard.risk: It looks like every gamified app, which is the 'generic' you ruled out.
